questions.question: What is the direction of an ascending pass for an amateur satellite?

choices.A: From west to east
choices.B: From east to west
choices.C: From south to north
choices.D: From north to south

questions.answer: From south to north

questions.question: Which of the following is characteristic of an inverting linear transponder?

choices.A: Doppler shift is reduced because the uplink and downlink shifts are in opposite directions
choices.B: Signal position in the band is reversed
choices.C: Upper sideband on the uplink becomes lower sideband on the downlink, and vice versa
choices.D: All these choices are correct

questions.answer: All these choices are correct

questions.question: How is an upload signal processed by an inverting linear transponder?

choices.A: The signal is detected and remodulated on the reverse sideband
choices.B: The signal is passed through a nonlinear filter
choices.C: The signal is reduced to I and Q components, and the Q component is filtered out
choices.D: The signal is mixed with a local oscillator signal and the difference product is transmitted

questions.answer: The signal is mixed with a local oscillator signal and the difference product is transmitted

questions.question: What is meant by the “mode” of an amateur radio satellite?

choices.A: Whether the satellite is in a low earth or geostationary orbit
choices.B: The satellite’s uplink and downlink frequency bands
choices.C: The satellite’s orientation with respect to the Earth
choices.D: Whether the satellite is in a polar or equatorial orbit

questions.answer: The satellite’s uplink and downlink frequency bands

questions.question: What do the letters in a satellite’s mode designator specify?

choices.A: Power limits for uplink and downlink transmissions
choices.B: The location of the ground control station
choices.C: The polarization of uplink and downlink signals
choices.D: The uplink and downlink frequency ranges

questions.answer: The uplink and downlink frequency ranges

questions.question: What are Keplerian elements?

choices.A: Parameters that define the orbit of a satellite
choices.B: Phase reversing elements in a Yagi antenna
choices.C: High-emission heater filaments used in magnetron tubes
choices.D: Encrypting codes used for spread spectrum modulation

questions.answer: Parameters that define the orbit of a satellite

questions.question: Which of the following types of signals can be relayed through a linear transponder?

choices.A: FM and CW
choices.B: SSB and SSTV
choices.C: PSK and packet
choices.D: All these choices are correct

questions.answer: All these choices are correct

questions.question: Why should effective radiated power (ERP) be limited to a satellite that uses a linear transponder?

choices.A: To prevent creating errors in the satellite telemetry
choices.B: To avoid reducing the downlink power to all other users
choices.C: To prevent the satellite from emitting out-of-band signals
choices.D: To avoid interfering with terrestrial QSOs

questions.answer: To avoid reducing the downlink power to all other users

questions.question: What do the terms “L band” and “S band” specify?

choices.A: The 23- and 13-centimeter bands
choices.B: The 2-meter and 70-centimeter bands
choices.C: FM and digital store-and-forward systems
choices.D: Which sideband to use

questions.answer: The 23- and 13-centimeter bands

questions.question: What type of satellite appears to stay in one position in the sky?

choices.A: HEO
choices.B: Geostationary
choices.C: Geomagnetic
choices.D: LEO

questions.answer: Geostationary

questions.question: What type of antenna can be used to minimize the effects of spin modulation and Faraday rotation?

choices.A: A linearly polarized antenna
choices.B: A circularly polarized antenna
choices.C: An isotropic antenna
choices.D: A log-periodic dipole array

questions.answer: A circularly polarized antenna

questions.question: What is the purpose of digital store-and-forward functions on an amateur radio satellite?

choices.A: To upload operational software for the transponder
choices.B: To delay download of telemetry between satellites
choices.C: To hold digital messages in the satellite for later download
choices.D: To relay messages between satellites

questions.answer: To hold digital messages in the satellite for later download

questions.question: In digital television, what does a coding rate of 3/4 mean?

choices.A: 25% of the data sent is forward error correction data
choices.B: Data compression reduces data rate by 3/4
choices.C: 1/4 of the time interval is used as a guard interval
choices.D: Three, four-bit words are used to transmit each pixel

questions.answer: 25% of the data sent is forward error correction data

questions.question: How many horizontal lines make up a fast-scan (NTSC) television frame?
How is an interlaced scanning pattern generated in a fast-scan (NTSC) television system?

choices.A: By scanning two fields simultaneously
choices.B: By scanning each field from bottom-to-top
choices.C: By scanning lines from left-to-right in one field and right-to-left in the next
choices.D: By scanning odd-numbered lines in one field and even-numbered lines in the next

questions.answer: By scanning odd-numbered lines in one field and even-numbered lines in the next

questions.question: How is color information sent in analog SSTV?

choices.A: Color lines are sent sequentially
choices.B: Color information is sent on a 2.8 kHz subcarrier
choices.C: Color is sent in a color burst at the end of each line
choices.D: Color is amplitude modulated on the frequency modulated intensity signal

questions.answer: Color lines are sent sequentially

questions.question: Which of the following describes the use of vestigial sideband in analog fast-scan TV transmissions?

choices.A: The vestigial sideband carries the audio information
choices.B: The vestigial sideband contains chroma information
choices.C: Vestigial sideband reduces the bandwidth while increasing the fidelity of low frequency video components
choices.D: Vestigial sideband provides high frequency emphasis to sharpen the picture

questions.answer: Vestigial sideband reduces the bandwidth while increasing the fidelity of low frequency video components

questions.question: What is vestigial sideband modulation?

choices.A: Amplitude modulation in which one complete sideband and a portion of the other are transmitted
choices.B: A type of modulation in which one sideband is inverted
choices.C: Narrow-band FM modulation achieved by filtering one sideband from the audio before frequency modulating the carrier
choices.D: Spread spectrum modulation achieved by applying FM modulation following single sideband amplitude modulation

questions.answer: Amplitude modulation in which one complete sideband and a portion of the other are transmitted

questions.question: Which types of modulation are used for amateur television DVB-T signals?

choices.A: FM and FSK
choices.B: QAM and QPSK
choices.C: AM and OOK
choices.D: All these choices are correct

questions.answer: QAM and QPSK

questions.question: What technique allows commercial analog TV receivers to be used for fast-scan TV operations on the 70-centimeter band?

choices.A: Transmitting on channels shared with cable TV
choices.B: Using converted satellite TV dishes
choices.C: Transmitting on the abandoned TV channel 2
choices.D: Using USB and demodulating the signal with a computer sound card

questions.question: What kind of receiver can be used to receive and decode SSTV using the Digital Radio Mondiale (DRM) protocol?

choices.A: CDMA
choices.B: AREDN
choices.C: AM
choices.D: SSB

questions.question: What aspect of an analog slow-scan television signal encodes the brightness of the picture?

choices.A: Tone frequency
choices.B: Tone amplitude
choices.C: Sync amplitude
choices.D: Sync frequency

questions.answer: Tone frequency

questions.question: What is the function of the vertical interval signaling (VIS) code sent as part of an SSTV transmission?

choices.A: To lock the color burst oscillator in color SSTV images
choices.B: To identify the SSTV mode being used
choices.C: To provide vertical synchronization
choices.D: To identify the call sign of the station transmitting

questions.answer: To identify the SSTV mode being used

questions.question: What signals SSTV receiving software to begin a new picture line?

choices.A: Specific tone frequencies
choices.B: Elapsed time
choices.C: Specific tone amplitudes
choices.D: A two-tone signal
